newsitem.title: USA: Optical Cable Q3 sales increase.
newsitem.headline: Optical Cable Q3 sales increase.

text.p: Optical Cable Corp said on Tuesday its sales for the third quarter ended July 31 increased 32 percent to $14.3 million from the $10.9 million in the previous third quarter.
Robert Kopstein, president and chief executive officer said he is "more than comfortable" with estimates that the company will earn between $0.05 and $0.06 per share in the third quarter.
The company plans to report the results for its third quarter by the end of the month.
Optical Cable manufactures fiber optical cables for high bandwidth transmission of data, video and audio communications over moderate distances.
